resources.string: Clears every place you\'ve marked as been, lived in or want to visit. Cannot be undone — export a backup first if there\'s any doubt.

Every place you\'ve marked, your passports and your display settings are cleared from this phone, along with the snapshot Android\'s backup keeps. Google may still hold an earlier backup until Android next runs one — Android\'s backup settings can delete that now.
An independent app, not affiliated with or representing any government. Visa data is a snapshot and can be out of date: confirm entry rules with the official government source before you travel.
Borders from Natural Earth (public domain), drawn with MapLibre. The whole map is bundled in the app, so it works with no network and no account.

Android\'s own Auto Backup carries a snapshot of your history to your Google account — the system makes that copy, the app never uploads anything itself. A reinstalled or new phone starts empty: nothing is put back until you tap Restore. The database, your settings and a per-install id stay out of the backup entirely. Switch it off in Android\'s backup settings if you would rather it did not.
Visa-requirements dataset, derived from Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0), see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the repository
